title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06
source: 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips(Recorded By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel 2 Reel)- 1st Generation Cassettes (TDK SAX-100's) Transferred By Dick Latvala(Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer(Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise circa late 1990's) Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name); Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a relaxed Fillmore West set featuring a smoking Alligator jam, tight Dancing in the Street and a fierce Not Fade Away.
ai_review.review: The upgraded soundboard source is virtually hiss‑free and sounds magnificent, letting listeners hear Pigpen’s organ roar like Janis Joplin and the superb drumming throughout. Musically the band stretches out on the second half – Alligator, Not Fade Away and a tight Dancing in the Street flow smoothly and showcase the group’s relaxed, exploratory vibe at the Fillmore West.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently praise both the high‑fidelity soundboard recording and the strong second‑half performance, with only minor comments about an unremarkable first half.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeably less hiss than earlier releases, no degradation, crisp mix; reviewers call the sound magnificent and note superb drumming capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First half deemed ordinary, but the band relaxes and segues into extended grooves on the second half; Alligator jam leads into a tight Dancing in the Street and a punchy Not Fade Away.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is highlighted, sounding like Janis Joplin and praised for his plug‑in moment.
band_member_comments.Drums: Superb drumming noted throughout the performance.
